s: Ravanni Valasanaini, the visually impaired para-athlete who won two bronze medals at the 5th Asian Para Games 2026, hails from which district of Andhra Pradesh?
x: Ravanni Valasanaini is from Paderu (Rangasingipaadu tribal hamlet) in ASR district; she won bronze in the women's 400 m and 1,500 m. Eluru is Ravi Karthik Budigina's district; Anakapalli is Ravi Rongali's.

s:
Consider the following statements about the 5th Asian Para Games 2026:
1. They were held at Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, from 18 to 24 October 2026.
2. India won 114 medals, including 30 gold.
3. The first Asian Para Games were held at Incheon in 2014.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: India's 97 para-athletes won 114 medals (30 gold, 35 silver, 49 bronze) at Aichi-Nagoya, 18-24 Oct 2026. The first Asian Para Games were at Guangzhou, China, in 2010, so statement 3 is wrong.

s:
Match the AP para-athletes/officials (Asian Para Games 2026) with their achievement:
A. Ravanni Valasanaini   1. Silver, men's 100 m freestyle swimming
B. Ravi Karthik Budigina   2. Bronze, men's shot put
C. Ravi Rongali   3. Two bronze, women's 400 m and 1,500 m
D. M.V. Murali Krishna   4. Coach, Indian para-badminton team
x: Ravanni (ASR) - two bronze in 400 m and 1,500 m; Budigina (Eluru) - silver in 100 m freestyle; Rongali (Anakapalli) - bronze in shot put; Murali Krishna (Visakhapatnam) - para-badminton coach.

s: Ravi Karthik Budigina of Jangareddygudem (Eluru) made history at the 5th Asian Para Games 2026 because his silver medal was
o: India's first swimming medal at the Asian Para Games
x: His silver in the men's 100 m freestyle was India's first swimming medal at the Games; he added two more medals.

s: How many national awards did Andhra Pradesh's urban local bodies win in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26, presented in New Delhi in November 2026?
x: Six AP ULBs were awarded: GVMC, Vijayawada, Guntur, Tirupati and Rajamahendravaram Municipal Corporations and Kuppam Municipality.

s: Which one of the following urban local bodies of Andhra Pradesh was NOT among the six AP award winners in Swachh Survekshan 2025-26?
x: The six AP winners were GVMC, Vijayawada, Guntur, Tirupati, Rajamahendravaram and Kuppam; Nellore was not among them.

s: In the Swachh Shehar Jodi category of Swachh Survekshan 2025-26, which AP pair (Mentor - Mentee) was among the top three nationally?
x: Tirupati (Mentor City) and Kuppam (Mentee City) were among the top three Swachh Shehar Jodis; Tirupati also won the Super Swachh League award for the fourth straight year.

s:
Consider the following statements about Swachh Survekshan 2025-26:
1. Vijayawada was among the top three Clean Cities of the Super Swachh League, along with Navi Mumbai and Surat.
2. Swachh Survekshan was launched in 2016 by the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs under SBM-Urban.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Both are correct: Vijayawada was in the top three of the Super Swachh League with Navi Mumbai and Surat; the survey began in 2016 under MoHUA's SBM-Urban (2025-26 = 10th edition).

s: Which State topped the Access (In)Equality Index (AEI) 2026, in which Andhra Pradesh was ranked second?
x: Goa was first (0.68), AP second (0.66) and Sikkim third in AEI 2026.

s: The Access (In)Equality Index 2026, in which AP was declared a 'Front Runner', is prepared by
o: Centre for New Economic Studies, O.P. Jindal Global University
Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
x: AEI (since 2021) is a composite index of the Centre for New Economic Studies (CNES), O.P. Jindal Global University, with 5 dimensions and 60 indicators.

s: In the Access (In)Equality Index 2026, Andhra Pradesh ranked first in which dimension?
x: AP scored 0.69 in socio-economic security, first nationally (Goa 0.50), though AP is 13th in per capita income.

s: Which State ranked first in the Ease of Vehicle Ownership Index (EVOI) published in November 2026 for smooth used-vehicle ownership transfer?
x: AP led the EVOI (IndiaTech.org with Consumer VOICE), followed by Kerala and Tamil Nadu; Delhi was 4th and Uttar Pradesh last.

s:
Consider the following statements about the National SARAS Mela 2026:
1. Andhra Pradesh came first in State-wise sales with about Rs 2.99 crore.
2. Uttar Pradesh came second in State-wise sales.
3. It was held at R.K. Beach, Visakhapatnam.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: AP led with Rs 2.99 crore (~23% of Rs 12.84 crore total), UP second (Rs 1.22 crore). The mela was at Punnami Ghat, Vijayawada, not Visakhapatnam.

s: The 16th-century inscriptions of Achyutadevaraya discovered by the ASI at the Tirumala Sri Venkateswara temple in November 2026 are written in
x: Both inscriptions (south and north walls of the third prakaram) are in Tamil.

s: Achyutadevaraya, whose inscriptions were found at Tirumala in November 2026, belonged to which dynasty of the Vijayanagara Empire?
x: Achyutadevaraya (1529-1542) of the Tuluva dynasty succeeded his half-brother Krishnadevaraya and was first crowned at Tirupati.

s: 'Achyutarayabhyudayam' was composed by Achyutadevaraya's court poet
x: Rajanatha Dindima, court poet of Achyutadevaraya, wrote Achyutarayabhyudayam; Peddana, Timmana and Tenali Rama are linked to Krishnadevaraya's court.

s: The 'Abhaya Shasanam' (charter of security to merchants) at Motupalli in present Bapatla district was issued by
x: Kakatiya ruler Ganapatideva issued the Abhaya Shasanam at Motupalli in 1244-45 CE; Anavota Reddy's Motupalli inscription is of 1358 CE.

s:
Arrange the following in chronological order:
1. Founding of the Dutch East India Company (VOC)
2. Anavota Reddy's inscription at Motupalli
3. Ganapatideva's Abhaya Shasanam at Motupalli
4. Dutch factory at Masulipatnam
x: Abhaya Shasanam 1244-45 CE, Anavota Reddy's inscription 1358 CE, VOC founded 1602, Dutch factory at Masulipatnam 1605.

s:
C.P. Brown's birth anniversary was commemorated by the AP Chief Minister in November 2026. Consider:
1. He was born on 10 November 1798 in Calcutta.
2. He published 'A Dictionary, Telugu and English' in 1852.
3. He died at Kadapa, where the C.P. Brown Library stands.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Brown was born 10 Nov 1798 in Calcutta and published his Telugu-English dictionary in 1852; the library is at Kadapa but he died in London on 12 Dec 1884.

s: Retired IAS officer Binoy Kumar was appointed in November 2026 as Chairperson of
x: Binoy Kumar became APERC Chairperson on 4 Nov 2026, succeeding P. Venkata Rama Reddy; APERC was set up on 31 March 1999 under the AP Electricity Reform Act, 1998.

s: Union Civil Aviation Minister K. Ram Mohan Naidu was named in November 2026 among the '38 by 38' Achievers of
x: Purdue University's College of Engineering (award instituted 2024, inspired by Neil Armstrong) named him; he did his BSEE at Purdue in 2008.

s:
Match the persons in news (Nov 2026) with the reason:
A. Binoy Kumar   1. NMC representative on AP Higher Education Fee Regulatory and Monitoring Committee
B. P. Chandrasekhar   2. Chairperson, APERC
C. J.T. Amareswar   3. Silver in Sports Aerobics, CBSE National Championship
D. K. Sri Sarayu   4. Best Mechanical Engineering Student-2026 award, ISTE AP Section
x: Binoy Kumar - APERC Chairperson; P. Chandrasekhar - NMC nominee on APHEFRMC; J.T. Amareswar - ISTE AP Best Mechanical Engineering Student; K. Sri Sarayu - U-17 Sports Aerobics silver.

s: According to a Supreme Court ruling of November 2026, the 24-hour period under Article 22(2) for producing an arrested person before a magistrate begins from
o: the time the FIR is registered
the time the arrest is formally recorded
the time the person is taken to the police station
x: The SC held the 24-hour clock starts from the time of detention, not when the agency formally records the arrest.

s:
Consider the following statements regarding Article 22:
1. A person arrested under an ordinary law must be produced before a magistrate within 24 hours, excluding journey time.
2. Preventive detention beyond three months requires a report of an Advisory Board.
3. The safeguards against preventive detention are available only to citizens.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; the preventive-detention safeguards are available to both citizens and aliens.

s: Which section of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023 bars keeping a person arrested without warrant in custody beyond 24 hours without a magistrate's special order?
x: Section 58 BNSS carries the 24-hour limit; Section 47 is about informing the arrested person of grounds and bail rights.

s: In November 2026 the Supreme Court recognised children's access to the internet as a fundamental right under
x: In a November 2026 ruling (as reported by CivicCentre IAS, 12 Nov 2026) the Court tied children's internet access to Articles 21 and 19(1)(a) and refused a blanket social-media ban for children.

s: In Unni Krishnan J.P. v. State of Andhra Pradesh (1993), the Supreme Court held that
o: the right to education flows from Article 21
the right to privacy is a fundamental right
internet access is a fundamental right
x: A five-judge bench in Unni Krishnan (1993) held the right to education flows directly from Article 21; privacy was Puttaswamy (2017).

s:
Assertion (A): In November 2026 the Supreme Court held that OBC creamy-layer status cannot be decided solely on the basis of the parents' salary or income.
Reason (R): The DoPT Office Memorandum of 1993 excluded income from salary and agricultural sources from the income/wealth test and made the status and category of the parents' post relevant.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
x: The Court relied on the 1993 OM, which excluded salary and agricultural income from the income test, so social status and category of the parents' post must be considered.

s: According to the SRS Statistical Report 2024 cited when the Supreme Court questioned two-child norm laws, India's Total Fertility Rate is
x: SRS 2024: India's TFR 1.9 (rural 2.1, urban 1.5), below the replacement level of 2.1.

s:
As per the SRS Statistical Report 2024, which of the following pairs is/are correctly matched?
1. Bihar - highest TFR (2.9)
2. Delhi - lowest TFR (1.2)
3. Kerala - TFR 2.1
Select the correct answer:
x: Bihar had the highest TFR (2.9) and Delhi the lowest (1.2); Kerala's TFR is 1.3, not 2.1.

s: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), referred to when the Supreme Court said 'cybercriminals have no place in society', functions under
x: I4C is an MHA initiative dedicated to the nation on 10 January 2020; CERT-In is under MeitY.

s: In November 2026 the Union Cabinet extended the Centrally Sponsored Scheme for Fast Track Special Courts up to
x: The FTSC scheme was continued for five years, 1 April 2026 to 31 March 2031.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Fast Track Special Courts (FTSC) scheme:
1. It began in October 2019 for time-bound trial of rape and POCSO Act cases.
2. The Central share is funded from the Nirbhaya Fund.
3. Its nodal ministry is the Ministry of Home Affairs.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: FTSCs began in Oct 2019 for rape and POCSO cases and the Central share comes from the Nirbhaya Fund; the nodal ministry is the Ministry of Law and Justice, not MHA.

s: What is the total financial outlay of the Fast Track Special Courts scheme extended in November 2026?
x: Outlay Rs 3,788.04 crore = Central share Rs 2,353.15 crore + State/UT share Rs 1,434.89 crore.

s: Under the change to the Agnipath scheme reported in November 2026, the remaining 75% of Agniveers
o: are released with a lump-sum Seva Nidhi after four years
get an additional two years of service and a chance to join the regular forces
are absorbed in the CAPFs automatically
x: Earlier only 25% were retained after 4 years; now the other 75% get 2 more years and can join the regular forces; the Government pays 70% of the Seva Nidhi for those leaving after the extra 2 years.

s: The 'Vayo Samman Rashtriya Abhiyan' launched in November 2026, based on a '5C' model, is implemented under
x: The Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment launched this intergenerational bonding campaign (Connect, Converse, Co-create, Contribute, Continue) under AVYAY (2021).

s:
Consider the following about CERT-In's AI security guidelines of November 2026:
1. Reportable AI-related security incidents must be disclosed within six hours.
2. AI systems are classified into four risk categories.
3. CERT-In functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: 6-hour reporting and four risk categories (low, moderate, high, critical) are correct; CERT-In (2004) is under MeitY, set up under Section 70B of the IT Act.

s: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA), which capped trade margins on 137 anti-cancer drugs in November 2026, is an attached office of
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
x: NPPA (1997) is an attached office of the Department of Pharmaceuticals and enforces the Drugs (Prices Control) Order.

s: As per Section 4(1) of the National Medical Commission Act, 2019, the NMC consists of how many members?
x: NMC has 33 members: a Chairperson, 10 ex officio and 22 part-time members.

s: The Chairman and members of a State Public Service Commission hold office for six years or until they attain the age of
x: SPSC members serve 6 years or till age 62; for UPSC members the age limit is 65.

s: Which one of the following statements about a State Public Service Commission is NOT correct?
o: Its Chairman and members are appointed by the Governor.
They can be removed only by the President.
The Governor can remove a member for misbehaviour after a Supreme Court inquiry.
The Supreme Court's advice in a misbehaviour inquiry binds the President.
x: Removal is only by the President, never by the Governor; for misbehaviour the President refers the matter to the Supreme Court, whose advice is binding.

s: Which one of the following States was NOT formed (or reorganised) on 1 November 1956?
x: AP, Karnataka, Kerala, MP and TN date from 1 Nov 1956; Punjab and Haryana from 1 Nov 1966; Chhattisgarh was carved out of MP on 1 Nov 2000.

s: The admission into the Union of India of territories not previously part of it, or establishment of new States there, is provided for by
x: Article 2 covers admission/establishment of new States from outside; Article 3 is internal reorganisation (new States, areas, boundaries, names).

s: Karnataka's 2018 proposal for an official State flag, recalled when the State considered recognising the Kannada flag in November 2026, was rejected by
x: The 2018 proposal needed Flag Code changes and was rejected by MHA; the State now intends to keep the red-and-yellow Kannada flag.

s: What was India's all-India CPI (combined) inflation for October 2026, released on 12 November 2026?
x: Oct 2026 CPI inflation was 6.09% (provisional, base 2024=100), up from 5.54% in Sep; 6.63% is rural and 8.94% is food (CFPI).

s:
Consider the following about CPI data for October 2026:
1. Rural inflation (6.63%) was higher than urban inflation (5.41%).
2. Food inflation based on CFPI was 8.94%.
3. The CPI series uses 2012 as its base year.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Rural 6.63% > urban 5.41%, CFPI 8.94%; the current CPI base year is 2024 (=100), not 2012.

s: Among major States, which recorded the highest headline CPI inflation in October 2026?
x: Tamil Nadu 7.29% was highest, followed by Telangana 7.26%, AP 7.25%, MP 7.19% and Odisha 7.17%.

s: Andhra Pradesh's CPI inflation in October 2026 and its position among the high-inflation major States were
x: AP recorded 7.25%, third after Tamil Nadu (7.29%) and Telangana (7.26%).

s: Which item showed the highest year-on-year inflation at the all-India level in October 2026 CPI data?
x: Onion inflation was 116.22%, ahead of garlic (60.74%) and silver jewellery (52.39%); potato had the lowest (-14.24%).

s: The monthly Consumer Price Index (base 2024=100) released on 12 November 2026 is compiled by
o: Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT
x: CPI is compiled and released by the NSO (MoSPI); WPI is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT.

s: CPI inflation of 6.09% in October 2026 crossed the RBI's upper tolerance limit. Under the flexible inflation targeting framework, the RBI is deemed to have failed the target when
o: inflation exceeds 6% in any single month
average inflation is outside 2-6% for three consecutive quarters
food inflation exceeds 8% for two quarters
x: A single monthly breach is not a failure; failure means average inflation outside the 2-6% band for three consecutive quarters.

s: On 11 November 2026, the Union Cabinet extended the Stand-Up India scheme to 31 March 2031 with a credit guarantee corpus of
x: Stand-Up India got a Rs 4,111 crore credit guarantee corpus; Rs 5,000 crore is the CGFMU (MUDRA) corpus approved the same day.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Stand-Up India scheme:
1. It facilitates bank loans above Rs 10 lakh and up to Rs 1 crore for greenfield enterprises.
2. Each bank branch is to lend to at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower.
3. The credit guarantee covers 75% of the loan amount.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Loans are Rs 10 lakh-1 crore with one SC/ST and one woman borrower per branch; the guarantee covers 85% of the loan, not 75%.

s: The Stand-Up India scheme, extended in November 2026, was originally launched in
x: It was launched in April 2016 and has facilitated loans to over 2.75 lakh women, SC and ST entrepreneurs.

s: The Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU), continued till 31 March 2031 with a Rs 5,000 crore corpus, guarantees loans given under
x: CGFMU backs about Rs 12.6 lakh crore of PM MUDRA Yojana loans over five years; its trustee is NCGTC.

s: Under the CGFMU continuation approved in November 2026, the annual guarantee fee was
x: The guarantee fee was reduced from 1% to 0.75% per annum.

s: The Nutrient Based Subsidy (about Rs 62,370 crore) approved for Rabi 2026-27 on 11 November 2026 applies to
x: NBS covers P&K fertilisers (DAP, NPKS grades) for 1 Oct 2026-31 Mar 2027; urea is not under NBS. DAP stays at Rs 1,350 per 50 kg bag.

s: The Semicon 2.0 programme, whose web portal was launched in November 2026, has an outlay of
x: Semicon 2.0 (Cabinet, 15 July 2026) has Rs 1,27,500 crore and six pillars; Rs 76,000 crore was ISM 1.0 (Dec 2021).

s:
Match the scheme with its outlay/corpus:
A. Semicon 2.0   1. Rs 76,000 crore
B. India Semiconductor Mission 1.0   2. Rs 3,030 crore
C. BHAVYA Rasayan   3. Rs 1,27,500 crore
D. Stand-Up India (2026 corpus)   4. Rs 4,111 crore
x: Semicon 2.0 Rs 1,27,500 crore; ISM 1.0 Rs 76,000 crore; BHAVYA Rasayan Rs 3,030 crore; Stand-Up India guarantee corpus Rs 4,111 crore.

s:
Consider the following about the BHAVYA Rasayan scheme:
1. It aims to set up three dedicated chemical parks.
2. The Centre gives a grant of up to Rs 500 crore per park.
3. Each park will cover at least 8 sq km (2,000 acres).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Three parks of at least 2,000 acres each; the Centre gives up to Rs 1,000 crore per park, with a minimum State contribution of Rs 500 crore.

s: As highlighted in November 2026, India's rank as a producer of chemicals is
o: 3rd in the world and 2nd in Asia
6th in the world and 4th in Asia
4th in the world and 3rd in Asia
8th in the world and 5th in Asia
x: India is the 6th-largest chemicals producer globally and 4th in Asia; it is 2nd in dyes and 3rd in agrochemical exports.

s: The PLI Scheme for Medical Devices (PLI-MD), for which fresh applications were invited in November 2026, is administered by
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
x: PLI-MD (2020-21, extended to 2035-36) is under the Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers; incentive is 5% of incremental sales.

s: Which company became the first Indian copper producer to receive Veramark Assurance (formerly Copper Mark) certification in November 2026?
x: Kutch Copper Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of Adani Enterprises, was the first Indian copper producer to get it.

s: National Entrepreneurship Day, observed on 9 November, marks the establishment in 2014 of
o: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
x: The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship was set up on 9 Nov 2014; India has 2.62 lakh DPIIT-recognised start-ups (Nov 2026).

s:
Consider the following findings of ICRIER's report 'The Participation Paradox' (Nov 2026):
1. The number of working women nearly doubled from 104 million to 201 million between 2017-18 and 2025.
2. A rural woman's earnings relative to a rural man rose from 45% to 53%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Working women rose from 104 to 201 million (female WPR 22% to 38%), but a rural woman now earns about 45% of a rural man's pay, down from 53%.

s: According to the World Bank's International Debt Report 2026, India's external debt in 2025 stood at about
x: India's external debt was USD 763.5 billion in 2025 (USD 717.4 billion in 2024); USD 9.4 trillion is all developing countries' external debt.

s: The finding that nearly 90% of India's workforce remains informally employed, cited in the November 2026 'decent work' debate, comes from
x: The India Employment Report 2024 by ILO and the Institute for Human Development puts informal employment at ~90%; unemployment fell from 6.1% (2017-18) to 3.2% (2023-24).
